text:
Clara (PM): quick thread to lock the 'compact' design-partner plan. goal: low-friction onboarding, predictable SE load, and a fast replacement path. final before I publish the one-pager.

Owen (SWE): ops constraints first: we can support up to 9 active partners if average SE time <=2h/week each. above that we need a rotation. propose per-partner cap = 2h/week for "active" partners.

Maya (Solutions): recruitment filter: live integration + at least one production use-case doc. scoring: usage(50), available POC hours(30), strategic fit(20). require named POC & timezone.

Hector (Design): feedback format: micro-feedback (one 3-question form after each milestone) + optional 20m recorded session for deep partners. keep forms scannable and only 3 fields.

Gwen (Legal): legal: one-line addendum for telemetry consent + feedback IP license. fast e-sign. no custom terms for SMBs. flag regulated customers for extra review.

Clara (PM): my draft: slots=10 (6 Active / 2 Light / 2 OnDemand). Active = ~2h/wk, Light = async 1 form/2w, OnDemand fill-in. Incentives: Active=$750 credit + 1 exec sync; Light=$200 credit. small micro-bounty: $150 if partner returns 100% of milestone feedback on time month 1.

Owen (SWE): technical: allow a single KV-cache warmup window (7 days) for Active partners only. require teardown hook. tag pilot traffic with pilot_id. add quota isolation to avoid noisy neighbors.

Maya (Solutions): replacement rule: if partner misses 2 required milestone forms or misses 2 scheduled calls w/o reschedule -> probation. probation = auto-email + 72h to respond, else slot released to waitlist. pilot-bot: can you run that?

pilot-bot: probation flow created 12: send probation email -> 72h window -> if no response mark slot released -> notify top waitlist with 48h accept window.

Hector (Design): invite UX: show a "time commitment" badge (Active=~2h/week, Light=~1h/2w), checkbox for telemetry opt-in, and a short checklist of onboarding steps (smoke test, kickoff recorded, baseline form).

Gwen (Legal): privacy: mark health/finance as high-compliance. those need security contact and may add 7-14 days onboarding. add a single-question survey item to flag regulated industries.

Clara (PM): acceptance gates to mark partner "active": smoke test passed, baseline survey returned, kickoff recorded, telemetry consent (if opted-in). program success: avg structured feedback >=6/10 and >=2 actionable items identified in first 30 days.

Owen (SWE): rollback policy: if partner triggers cross-customer regression we will roll back partner changes immediately; also pause their slot until RCA. incidents tagged with pilot_id.

Maya (Solutions): scheduling note: cap overlapping Active partners in the same 4-hour window to 3 to avoid SE overload. I'll add timezone columns in sheet.

Hector (Design): measurement: sentiment (-2..+2), feedback completion rate, avg response latency, and actionable-count. show per-slot on the pilot dashboard.

Clara (PM): recruitment email draft: "Short: inviting a small group to a compact pilot of Redwood inference features. Active asks ~2h/week (calls + 3-question forms). Incentive $750 credit + exec sync. Can you commit? Please share POC & timezone & security contact."

Gwen (Legal): add final: require checkbox in invite: "We confirm right to share telemetry and accept the pilot addendum." link the addendum.

Owen (SWE): one more ops ask: log any extra SE time as ticketed 'scope overage' so we can track and decide if partner funds deeper work.

Clara (PM): great. I'll fold this into a 1-page playbook and the invite spreadsheet. thumbs?

Owen (SWE): :thumbsup:

Maya (Solutions): :thumbsup:

Hector (Design): :thumbsup:

Gwen (Legal): :thumbsup:

Clara (PM): thanks all 11 I'll send invites 09:00 PT tomorrow and feed pilot-bot the list. ping me if something blocks overnight.
